free.text: I search the ferry-house for whoever cut the bell rope.
I tell Wenna we will bring Pell home, and ask her for the safe path.
I follow the old timber posts into the reeds toward the camp.

combat.text: I swing my longsword at the goblin in the pot-helm.

fallback.text: I look the stranger in the eye and ask what they want from us.
I crouch and study the mud, the posts and the chain for anything out of place.
I offer a fair trade and promise no harm if they let us pass.
I keep to the old posts and edge toward the reed camp.
I ready my sword, lower my voice and step forward slowly.
